notes.title: Scorched Islands update
notes.content:
More scorching:
- more game modes - tournament up to 50 rounds with weapon purchasing between
- more weapons - 3 new weapons including NUKE!
- more destructibles
Also bug fixes and performance optimizations.

notes.content:
Scorched Islands for MAC OS released.

 64-bit version meeting latest system update requirements
